assertion_analysis.failure_condition: An empty, wrong or misparsed pinned policy omits the independently known Git Safety block; this is the positive input control.

Restore the retired fleet heading in FLEET_COMPUTE_HEADER and the mapping, or remove a mapped heading from POLICY: the pinned literal headers remain independent and implement/test fail, as both red logs demonstrate.
Restore the retired committed compute digest or remove its new fleet heading: the literal required-heading assertion fails.
Restore or append the retired heading to a committed compute digest: the forbidden-heading assertion fails even if the new heading is also present.

Keep the new heading but truncate or change the pinned fleet paragraph in a committed digest: membership of the independent POLICY block fails; changing the lookup header cannot make the pinned block follow it.
